pages.quiz:
ESSENTIAL MATHEMATICS — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #3
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: ESSENTIAL MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 5 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 40
   B. 75
   C. 20
   D. 30

2. What is √64? (1 mark)
   A. 8
   B. 9
   C. 32
   D. 64

3. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 5 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 16
   B. 32
   C. 55
   D. 22

4. Which is greater: 1/4 or 1/2? (1 mark)
   A. Cannot tell
   B. 1/4
   C. 1/2
   D. They are equal

5. Calculate 15 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 15.6
   B. 21
   C. 15.7
   D. 15

6. Calculate 19 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 25
   B. 19.6
   C. 19
   D. 19.7

7. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 6x + 2
   B. 12x
   C. 6x
   D. 12x + 2

8. Which inequality means “x is greater than 5”? (1 mark)
   A. x > 5
   B. x < 5
   C. x ≥ 0 only
   D. x = 5

9. Calculate 31 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 31.6
   B. 31.7
   C. 37
   D. 31

10. 1 hectare equals how many square metres? (1 mark)
   A. 100 m²
   B. 10 000 m²
   C. 1000 m²
   D. 100 000 m²

11. Find the GCD of 37 and 49. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 37
   C. 1
   D. 1

12. Calculate 27 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 33
   B. 27.6
   C. 27
   D. 27.7

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. Show full working: A trader sells 17 items at Ksh 55 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

14. Show full working: A trader sells 18 items at Ksh 60 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

15. Show full working: A trader sells 19 items at Ksh 65 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

16. Show full working: A trader sells 12 items at Ksh 70 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
